Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

bourse 0.1.0

  • The package has a logo.
  • README carries status badges and lists related packages.
  • CI runs lintr (report-only) and test coverage.

Testing

  • The recorded Binance responses were captured again on 2026-09-25, which restarts the 90-day re-grounding window. The asserted facts still match the new capture.

Documentation

  • Fixed a missing possessive in the package description (“the exchange own catalogue” -> “the exchange’s own catalogue”), corrected on DESCRIPTION, the package-level roxygen block and man/bourse-package.Rd.
  • Fixed a garbled, semicolon-spliced sentence in the Getting started with bourse vignette’s opening section (the intended sense, already correct in README.md, is “a trading system that is risk control, not bookkeeping”).
  • Replaced stray Unicode en dashes and curly quotation marks in README.md with the house-style ASCII -- and straight quotes (README.Rmd, the knitted source, was already clean).

bourse 0.1.0

Broadens coverage from the single-symbol Binance-spot-OHLCV connector to a multi-symbol connector with three read-only market-data verbs, while keeping the Independent Oracle Principle (IOP) as a first-class constraint: every new external fact is grounded against a recorded-real authority response before it is trusted.

New features

  • bourse_orderbook() fetches or parses the top-of-book order book from /api/v3/depth and returns a grounded order_book (the bids / asks price/qty ladders), or a bourse_refusal – including a refusal for a crossed book (best bid not below best ask), the structural impossibility that catches a transposed ladder.
  • bourse_ticker() fetches or parses the 24-hour rolling-window statistics from /api/v3/ticker/24hr and returns a grounded market_ticker, or a refusal. Its validator rejects an inverted high/low envelope.
  • Both verbs follow the established pattern: an offline parse path always available (pass the recorded payload), a live path Suggests-gated on httr2 + jsonlite, an obs_schema describing each column’s quantity and unit, and a grounding label combined worst-case from the facts the object rests on.

Multi-symbol grounding

  • bourse_catalogue_diff() now grounds the multi-symbol core universe (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, BNBUSDT, SOLUSDT) by default. Each requested symbol’s filters (tick size, lot size, minimum notional) and currencies must agree with the catalogue for the corresponding family to ground; a single missing symbol leaves symbol_universe [unverified], not silently grounded.

External data contracts

  • Two new fact families – orderbook_column_semantics and ticker_column_semantics – join the provenance registry, grounded by recorded-real property oracles on the captured depth and ticker payloads.
  • The recorded-real cassettes were re-captured against the live Binance authority on 2026-06-13 (the re-grounding step, restarting the 90-day window), and a multi-symbol /exchangeInfo cassette was added. New cassettes: binance_exchangeInfo_multi.json, binance_depth_BTCUSDT.json, binance_ticker24hr_BTCUSDT.json. All are hash-pinned in fixtures/PROVENANCE.md (sha256 + md5) with the md5 asserted in-test as the meta-oracle; a silent re-record fails loudly.
  • data-raw/record_fixtures.R now captures all five cassettes (single- and multi-symbol catalogue, klines, depth, ticker) and prints their new hashes.

Known gaps

  • fee_schedule remains [unverified]. Its authority is the authenticated /sapi/v1/asset/tradeFee endpoint, which would introduce an API credential surface; it is deliberately not implemented (see SECURITY.md). The registry reports it [unverified] rather than substituting a documentation default it cannot diff against the account’s actual fee tier.

Release ceremony

  • Added inst/CITATION (version read from package metadata), CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md; completed _pkgdown.yml with a grouped reference index; reconciled .Rbuildignore to the files that exist.

bourse 0.0.0.9000 (development)

First development version. bourse is the market-data connector of the ORCHESTRA analytics framework – the trading-domain counterpart of terroir – built with the Independent Oracle Principle as a first-class constraint from day one.

New features

  • bourse_ohlcv() fetches or parses an OHLCV candle series and returns a grounded market_series, or a bourse_refusal when it will not stand behind the result (unknown source, malformed candles, missing HTTP backend).
  • bourse_external_facts() and bourse_fact_status() expose the provenance registry: every asserted fact (symbol universe, tick size, lot size, minimum notional, fee schedule, currencies, timestamp convention, column semantics) is recorded with the date it was last diffed against the exchange, NA until grounded.
  • bourse_catalogue_diff() is the grounding oracle: it diffs the asserted facts against the exchange’s own /exchangeInfo catalogue and grounds those that agree with a real date – the only operation that moves a fact from [unverified] to grounded.
  • grounding_grounded(), grounding_unverified(), combine_grounding() are the canonical federation provenance tokens; is_refusal() and fact_grounding() are the gates a consumer reads before acting.

The live exchange path uses the suggested httr2 + jsonlite; the parsing, grounding, and refusal logic is exercised offline against recorded-real catalogue and candle fixtures.

External data contracts

  • Recorded-real Binance cassettes (tests/testthat/fixtures/binance_*BTCUSDT*.json, captured 2026-06-11, hash-pinned in fixtures/PROVENANCE.md) now back the offline oracle: test-catalogue-diff.R replays a real /exchangeInfo response and test-properties-recorded.R asserts physical / structural invariants on it (the silent-escape schema / units facts). These replace the prior hand-authored fixtures – the circular mock that let a stale filter name pass green.
  • Corrected the spot minimum-notional filter to NOTIONAL – Binance migrated it from the legacy MIN_NOTIONAL, and the live exchange exposes NOTIONAL. The catalogue diff accepts either for back-compat; the recorded-real property test fails loudly if a re-record reintroduces the legacy name.
  • .external_facts is now the canonical external-facts registry (family, kind, value, source, verified_on, reverify_by, oracle_types, signoff), validated per-family by .validate_external_registry() (gate F13/F14). Seven fact families are grounded by the recorded-real cassette; fee_schedule is reported as [unverified] (its auth-gated /sapi endpoint is unimplemented).
  • data-raw/record_fixtures.R re-captures the cassettes against the live authority and prints the new hashes (the re-grounding script).
